help.description: Displays this help message or details about a specific command.

options.name: -h
options.description: Displays help for the specified command or the list of commands.

parameters.description: Optional. The name of the command to display detailed help for.

ls.description: Lists files and directories in the current directory or a specific path.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the numeric folder ID instead of a path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the listing in raw JSON instead of rendering a table.

options.name: -l
options.description: Displays a detailed listing with type, size, date, and path.

options.name: -R
options.description: Lists subdirectories recursively.

options.name: --sort
options.description: Sorts results by name, date, size, or type.

parameters.description: Optional. The path of the directory to list or the ID when using -i/--id.

lsmedia.description: Lists media devices (cameras, microphones, speakers) connected to the system.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

lsusb.description: Lists connected USB devices that the browser has permission to access.

options.name: -c
options.description: Connects a USB device.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

lsgamepad.description: Lists gamepads and game controllers connected to the system.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

lsgpu.description: Displays basic GPU information of the system via WebGL.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

storage.description: Displays the content and usage of the browser's local storage (localStorage).

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

memory.description: Displays basic information about browser memory usage.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

connection.description: Displays network connection information (type, speed, etc.).

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

ip.description: Displays the user's public IP address.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

geo.description: Displays the user's geolocation information (latitude and longitude).

parameters.description: No parameters needed.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the numeric folder ID instead of a path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The path of the directory to navigate to or the folder ID when using -i/--id.

cat.description: Displays the content of a Cotton Cloud file. Always use -i with the file's numeric ID.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the file's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: -n
options.description: Numbers all output lines.

options.name: -b
options.description: Numbers only non-blank lines.

options.name: -s
options.description: Suppresses repeated blank lines.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the content in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The virtual path or ID of the file to display.

find.description: Searches for files and folders in Cotton Cloud by name or path term.

options.name: -t
options.description: Filters the result type: file, folder, or all.

options.name: -n
options.description: Returns only the names of the found items.

options.name: -c
options.description: Returns only the total number of found items.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the results in raw JSON instead of rendering a table.

parameters.description: The search term or virtual path.

grep.description: Searches for patterns in Cotton Cloud files. Always use -i with the file's numeric ID.

options.name: -i
options.description: Ignores case in the search.

options.name: -n
options.description: Displays the line number before each result.

options.name: -H
options.description: Always displays the filename before each result.

options.name: -h
options.description: Suppresses the display of the filename.

options.name: -v
options.description: Inverts the match: displays lines that do NOT match the pattern.

options.name: -L
options.description: Lists only files that do NOT have matches.

options.name: -l
options.description: Lists only files that have matches.

options.name: -c
options.description: Displays only the total number of matching lines per file.

options.name: -E
options.description: Interprets the pattern as an extended regular expression.

options.name: -e
options.description: Specifies the search pattern (useful for patterns starting with -).

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the results in raw JSON format.

parameters.description: Search pattern and one or more files/paths.

head.description: Displays the first lines of a Cotton Cloud file. Always use -i with the file's numeric ID.

options.name: -n
options.description: Number of lines to display.

options.name: -q
options.description: Does not display the filename header.

options.name: -v
options.description: Always displays the filename header.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the file's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The virtual path or ID of the file.

tail.description: Displays the last lines of a Cotton Cloud file. Always use -i with the file's numeric ID.

options.name: -n
options.description: Number of lines to display.

options.name: -q
options.description: Does not display the filename header.

options.name: -v
options.description: Always displays the filename header.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the file's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The virtual path or ID of the file.

sed.description: Edits text in a file without opening it, with support for search, replace, insert, and delete. Always use -i with the file's numeric ID.

options.name: -i
options.description: Saves changes directly to the file.

options.name: -n
options.description: Suppresses automatic line output.

options.name: -e
options.description: The sed expression to execute.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the file's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The virtual path or ID of the file, followed by sed expressions.

cc-resolve.description: Resolves a virtual path or numeric ID to Cotton Cloud metadata. Always use -i with the numeric ID.

options.name: -i
options.description: Treats the argument as the numeric ID of a file or folder.

options.name: --name-only
options.description: Returns only the name of the resolved item.

options.name: --path-only
options.description: Returns only the virtual path of the resolved item.

options.name: --type-only
options.description: Returns only the type of the resolved item (file or folder).

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the resolved metadata in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The Cotton virtual path or file/folder ID.

run.description: Executes a Shuttle (.shuttle) script stored in Cotton Cloud.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the script's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Simulates execution without applying changes.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Displays detailed output for each step.

options.name: --start-line
options.description: Starts execution from a specific line.

options.name: --end-line
options.description: Ends execution at a specific line.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The ID of the file or virtual path of the .shuttle script.

cotton-create.description: Creates a new file in Cotton Cloud in an existing folder. ALWAYS provide folder and name. Example: {"folder":"/docs", "name":"readme.md"}

options.name: --id
options.description: Uses the folder's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --folder
options.description: Virtual path or folder ID where to create the file. E.g., /docs or 42

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of the file to create. E.g., readme.md

options.name: --content
options.description: Initial content of the file.

options.name: --description
options.description: Optional description of the file.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: Required: folder + name.

cotton-save.description: Saves content in an existing Cotton Cloud file. Always use -i with the file's numeric ID.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the file's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --content
options.description: The complete content to save in the file.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The ID or virtual path of the file to save.

cotton-delete.description: Removes a file from Cotton Cloud.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the file's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The ID or virtual path of the file to delete.

mkdir.description: Creates a new directory at the specified path. ALWAYS provide the full path. Example: {"path":"/docs/new-folders"}

options.name: --parents
options.description: Creates parent directories automatically if they do not exist.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: Required: full path of the new directory.

rmdir.description: Removes a directory from Cotton Cloud, optionally with all its content.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the folder's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: -r
options.description: Removes the folder and all its content recursively.

options.name: -f
options.description: Forces permanent removal without sending to the trash.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: The virtual path or ID of the folder to remove.

mv.description: Moves a file or directory to another location in Cotton Cloud.

options.name: -f
options.description: Forces the move without confirmation.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: Source (file or folder) and destination (folder).

cp.description: Copies a file or directory to another location in Cotton Cloud, with support for recursive folder copying.

options.name: -i
options.description: Uses the source's numeric ID instead of a virtual path.

options.name: -r
options.description: Copies folders and their content recursively.

options.name: -f
options.description: Overwrites the destination if it already exists.

options.name: -n
options.description: Does not overwrite if the destination already exists.

options.name: --json
options.description: Returns the result in raw JSON.

parameters.description: Source (file or folder) and destination (folder).

nav.description: Displays information about the browser and operating system.

parameters.description: No parameters needed.
